text.en:
The Citizens Legal Assistance Office shall establish a District Office in every city or
municipality where a branch of the Court of First Instance is located. In accomplishing this objective, there
shall be created positions of Supervising Citizens attorneys, Senior Citizens attorneys, District Citizens
attorneys, Citizens attorneys, Senior Stenographers, and Clerks, in such number as may be necessary and as
may be determined under pertinent organization law.

To carry out the provisions of this Decree, the sum of seven million two hundred thousand pesos
(P7,200,000) is hereby authorized to be released out of the Special Activities Fund to cover costs incurred in

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty.
